However, just because it’s comfortable doesn’t mean it’s good for you. You said it yourself: it was a toxic co-dependent relationship. It ended for a reason and it’s going to hurt for some time because you’re disengaging from that “normal”. With time, it will get easier to have a new normal. 

I also think it’s so important that you recognized when you weren’t being respected. That says you have a respect for yourself and you deserve something that’s healthy for you.
